meta.title: Site content
meta.description: Edit the site's pages, preview a draft and publish it.

adminCms.title: Site content
adminCms.lead: Edit a page as a draft, see it on the site before anyone else does, then publish it as the next version.

denied.title: Only content managers can open this page
denied.body: Editing the site's pages is for content managers. Ask a super admin if you need the role.

list.caption: Every page you can edit, with its published version and any draft

later.title: This page's editor isn't ready yet
later.body: It still shows the text in the code. Its editor comes with the next part of the site content work.

state.notPublished: Not published yet. Until you publish version 1, the page shows the text in the code.
state.noDraft: No draft. Saving starts one from the text below.

form.heading: Edit the draft
form.label: Text
form.hint: Short-version points go first, each on a line starting with a dash. Start each section with two hash signs and its title. Write **bold** for strong words and [words](/page) for a link.
form.invalidBody: The text doesn't make a complete page. Check that every section has a title and some text.
form.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was saved. Please try again.

draft.heading: The draft
draft.lead: This is what publishing will show. Preview it on the site to see it in place.

notices.published: Published version {version}. The page shows it now.
notices.not_draft: That draft was already published. Here is the page as it is now.
notices.not_found: We couldn't find that draft. Here is the page as it is now.
notices.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing changed. Please try again.

revisions.heading: Versions
revisions.caption: Every version of this page, newest first

preview.draft: You're seeing the unpublished draft. Everyone else sees the published version.
preview.noDraft: This page has no unpublished draft, so you're seeing the published version.
